originalEntry.title: Hand-drawn promo for listing on AppSumo
originalEntry.author: mattbean
originalEntry.description: A 30-second drawing-style promo that walks through three steps of listing a product on AppSumo through your agent.
originalEntry.description_zh: 30 秒手绘风宣传短片，讲清用 agent 在 AppSumo 上架产品的三个步骤。
originalEntry.prompt:
build me a 30s drawing style animated clip about submitting a product to AppSumo via your agent.

steps are:
1. connect your agent
2. your agent fills out your listing and sets up redemption
3. go live!
originalEntry.prompt_zh:
给我做一段 30 秒的手绘风动画短片，讲如何通过你的 agent 把产品提交到 AppSumo。

步骤是：
1. 连接你的 agent
2. 你的 agent 填写产品页并设置兑换
3. 上线！
